title: Process Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The candidate must possess in\-depth functional knowledge of HR processes and apply it to operational scenarios to provide effective solutions. The candidate must be able to identify discrepancies and propose optimal solutions by using a logical, systematic, and sequential methodology. It is vital to be open\-minded towards inputs and views from team members and to effectively lead, control, and motivate groups towards company’s vision. Additionally, the candidate must be self\-directed, proactive and seize every opportunity to meet internal and external customer needs and achieve customer satisfaction by effectively auditing processes, implementing best people practices and process improvements, and utilizing the frameworks and tools available. Goals and thoughts must be clearly and concisely articulated and conveyed, verbally and in writing, to clients, colleagues, subordinates, and supervisors. The candidate should act as a change agent, acting as a catalyst to drive vertical/org. level changes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Employee Engagement \& Issue Resolution
   

  

* Understand employee pulse through regular connects and raise concerns to the right stakeholders.
* Ensure employee issues are resolved end\-to\-end with quick turnaround.
* Conduct one\-on\-one connects with the Analyst–Manager pool during pulse checks.
* Govern leadership connect sessions for the program.
* Manage attrition for the program and implement retention actions.


 Performance Management
   

  

* Partner with Business for performance calibration discussions.
* Conduct sessions to educate employees on the Performance Management System.
* Ensure timely goal\-setting between managers and their teams.
* Guide and train managers on the evaluation process.
* Monitor and govern PIP/Performance Coaching for bottom performers.
* Close calibration cycles with Business.


 Career \& Capability Development
   

  

* Run career development and capability\-building programs for identified A–PM talent.
* Coach employees to take ownership of their growth.
* Oversee the 90\-day onboarding and assimilation journey for Analyst–Manager pool.


 Discipline \& Compliance
   

  

* Investigate any conduct\-related issues and close them with appropriate disciplinary action when required.
* Complete exit interviews for Analyst–Process Manager employees within timelines.
* Ensure timely closure of Bottom Quartile cases.
* Close background verification issues for Analyst–Process Manager employees in the program.


 Reporting \& Governance
   

  

* Keep all trackers updated, including pulse, discipline, conduct, and performance.
* Share updated trackers with the Senior HRBP and other stakeholders.
* Create and maintain reports and dashboards for all program\-related HR activities.
* Drive Rewards \& Recognition programs to appreciate employee contributions and boost performance.


**Qualifications**
* Graduate with an MBA
* 5\+ years of total experience, with at least 3 years as an HR Business Partner in a KPO / IT / ITES environment
* Strong understanding of HR processes like performance management, employee engagement, attrition management, and capability development
* Experience handling employee relations, grievance resolution, and disciplinary processes

* Good communication, analytical, and reporting skills
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and driving HR initiatives end\-to\-end.

**Technical Excellence**
* Strong expertise in talent transformation initiatives, translating workforce needs into actionable advisory solutions. Proven capability in leadership development and succession planning to strengthen organizational bench depth. Skilled in organizational design, performance management, and career mapping to align talent structures with business goals. Ability to drive HR process efficiency, policy optimization, and organizational change management through structured consulting approaches.

**Qualification**
* Master of Business Administration
* PG Diploma in Human Resource Management


**Experience**
* Project Management (6\+ years)
* Business Analysis (3\+ years)
* Artificial Intelligence (3\+ years)
* HR Operations (4\+ years)
* Talent Acquisition (3\+ years)
* Customer Success Management (3\+ years)
* Business Intelligence (3\+ years)


**What We Look For**
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.

* Monitor labor costs in line with budget guidelines.

* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and Accor policies.
* Maintain positive relations with external authorities and stakeholders where required.
* HR Operations \& Administration
* Oversee HR administration, documentation, and record management.
* Ensure compliance with internal audits and corporate reporting requirements.
* Maintain HR systems and ensure data accuracy.
* Culture \& Brand Alignment
* Ensure implementation of Accor values and Heartist® culture across both properties.
* Support the integration of brand standards for Fairmont and Morgans Originals into daily operations.
* Promote a culture of professionalism, respect, and continuous improvement.

title: Fleet Personnel Officer
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Fleet Personnel Officer provides comprehensive communication, project coordination, executive and administrative support to the Head of Fleet Personnel. The role is responsible for managing high\-volume correspondence, coordinating departmental projects, monitoring actions and deliverables, and supporting the effective functioning of the Head of Fleet Personnel’s office.
   

  

 The position also supports departmental reporting, governance, seafarer welfare initiatives, union and CBA administration, forums, travel and selected operational matters. It requires a high degree of discretion, sound judgement, attention to detail and the ability to remain responsive while coordinating with senior leaders, Fleet Personnel teams, vessels, seafarers, manning partners, unions, vendors and other stakeholders across different time zones.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Email, Communication and Correspondence Management: 20%
* Manage and organise the Head of Fleet Personnel’s high\-volume email correspondence, ensuring messages are reviewed, prioritised and directed appropriately.
* Identify matters requiring immediate attention, follow\-up, delegation or escalation, and maintain visibility of pending responses and commitments.
* Draft, proofread and coordinate emails, letters, memos, presentations and other communications on behalf of the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Prepare standard departmental letters, invitation letters, confirmations and authorisation documents, and maintain appropriate records.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to obtain timely inputs and ensure correspondence is closed out accurately and professionally.
* Handle confidential, sensitive and privileged information with discretion.
* Project Coordination and Action Management: 20%
* Coordinate Fleet Personnel projects and improvement initiatives by maintaining project plans, milestones, actions, risks, decisions and deliverables.
* Proactively follow up with responsible stakeholders, identify potential delays and provide concise progress updates to the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Coordinate user inputs, testing, communications and implementation follow\-up for Fleet Personnel systems and digitalisation initiatives, including COMPAS and related crew\-management processes.
* Support the preparation of project briefs, presentations, status reports, process guidance, memos and rollout communications.
* Liaise with IT, Finance, HR, Training, regional teams and other functions to resolve dependencies and support timely delivery.
* Remain responsive to urgent project requirements and changing priorities arising from Seaspan’s global operations.
* Meetings, Minutes and Follow\-up Coordination: 10%
* Coordinate meeting logistics and prepare agendas, briefing notes and supporting materials for departmental, management and external stakeholder meetings.
* Record and circulate clear minutes of meetings and maintain action trackers with owners and target dates.
* Follow up on overdue actions and provide the Head of Fleet Personnel with timely updates on progress and outstanding matters.
* Coordinate the Fleet Personnel weekly meeting agenda and consolidate inputs from departmental and regional teams.
* Support meetings across time zones when operationally required.
* Reporting, Dashboards and Management Information: 10%
* Prepare and maintain periodic reports, dashboards, management information and KPI trackers for the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Gather and consolidate information from Fleet Personnel teams and company systems into structured summaries for leadership review.
* Support monthly management reporting, budget coordination, variance commentary and ad hoc analysis.
* Maintain accurate records of departmental actions, incidents, recognition, policy exceptions and other agreed metrics.
* Work accurately under tight timelines while managing multiple reporting requirements concurrently.
* CBA, Wage Scale, Vessel Data and Union Coordination: 10%
* Maintain trackers for Collective Bargaining Agreement renewals, vessel enrolments, correspondence and supporting documentation.
* Maintain controlled vessel and CBA data, including business unit, shipowner, flag, complement and applicable wage arrangements.
* Support the preparation, issue and recordkeeping of approved wage scales and related Fleet Personnel memoranda.
* Coordinate routine documentation and follow\-up with unions, manning partners and internal stakeholders under the guidance of the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Compliance, Audit and Document Control: 8%
* Support ISO, RPSL and other Fleet Personnel audit preparations, including document collection, tracker maintenance and closure of agreed actions.
* Assist with updates to departmental manuals, procedures, records and controlled documents.
* Maintain organised and secure digital and physical filing systems for the Head of Fleet Personnel’s office.
* Ensure records are complete, current, readily retrievable and handled in accordance with company confidentiality and data\-protection requirements.
* Seafarer Welfare, Insurance and Recognition Programmes: 7%
* Coordinate administrative aspects of seafarer medical and life\-insurance programmes, including data updates, supporting documentation and follow\-up with service providers.
* Support humanitarian\-aid and other urgent seafarer welfare arrangements as directed.
* Administer long\-service and loyalty\-recognition programmes, including eligibility records, approved awards, procurement coordination and event logistics.
* Maintain accurate records of recognition items and ensure expenditure remains within approved budgets and processes.
* Forums, Town Halls and Stakeholder Events: 5%
* Support the planning and execution of seafarer forums, vessel town halls, leadership visits, conferences, seminars, roadshows and sponsorship activities.
* Coordinate participant lists, invitations, venues, suppliers, presentation materials, awards and event budgets.
* Liaise with regional offices, vessels, manning partners and internal functions to ensure timely and efficient delivery.
* Maintain event plans, cost trackers, records and post\-event actions.
